purpose: Exposure row SAEA-SLURP-DIRECT-ONLY-FOLD-B-THINKING-PACKETS-GPU-V1 (owner decision 266-E, package docs/readiness/2026-10-11-slurp-direct-only-fold-b-thinking-vs-instruct-v1; re-registration of 2026-10-11 that supersedes SAEA-SLURP-DIRECT-ONLY-FOLD-B-THINKING-PACKETS-V1): materialize the Thinking-core speech-feature packets for SLURP-EVO-FOLD-B-V2 (1,080 rows, 3,154.797375 s) with the audio encoder on the GPU. The Instruct packets are not valid for the Thinking decoder (748 of 860 mmproj tensors differ), so the Thinking core needs its own packet root; the CPU sidecar pass encoded at 16-19 s per row and was stopped by the owner after 50 rows, and CPU- and GPU-made encoder outputs are not bit-identical, so this pass has its own packet root and legacy cache. Label-free: the GPU llama-server (the Thinking decoder AND its own bf16 mmproj, runtime-q4km-thinking-preprocess-gpu.json, -np 1 -ngl 999) is driven with one contact per row at max_tokens 1 under a fixed minimal instruction; the legacy feature-cache key is the FNV-1a hash of the media bytes ALONE, so the prompt cannot affect the cached features and no response is read semantically. No gold, sentence, transcript, scenario, action, intent, entity or score is opened. The server serves on 8081 only inside a serving-swap window in which no serving session is resident. Roster key thinking-smoke-4 encodes the first four rows into the legacy cache only (no promotion) as the 4-row proof of the fixed form; roster key thinking-fold-b encodes the remaining cold rows and promotes all 1,080 into the empty Thinking GPU packet root after a verified normal server stop.
